# BLAQUE BAUX

> BLAQUE BAUX is an open systematic research initiative for risk structure, strategy validation, portfolio governance, and disciplined execution.

## Canonical pages

- [BLAQUE BAUX](https://www.blaquebaux.com/): Overview of the research philosophy, governed system, and execution framework.
- [LABS](https://www.blaquebaux.com/labs/): Interactive surfaces for strategies in live operation or active validation.
- [THE CORPUS](https://www.blaquebaux.com/corpus/): The accumulated research record, including live, validating, experimental, and rejected work.
- [BLOCK](https://www.blaquebaux.com/block/): A complete visual reference to 120 derivative strategies across equity, rates, foreign exchange, credit, commodities, municipal finance, and funding. Each entry includes a description, structure map, payoff or settlement profile, formula, terms, and illustrative trade outcomes.

## BLOCK expanded strategy coverage

The 120-strategy BLOCK catalog includes the original 80 reference structures plus 40 expanded foundational and institutional structures:

- Equity: Long Call, Long Put, Covered Call, Protective Put, Bull Call Spread, Bear Put Spread, Butterfly Spread, Condor Spread, Iron Condor, Calendar Spread, Put Spread Collar, and Lookback Option.
- Rates and inflation: Interest Rate Basis Swap, Constant Maturity Swap, CMS Spread Option, Range Accrual, Zero-Coupon Inflation Swap, and Inflation Cap / Floor.
- Credit: CDS Index Tranche, Bespoke CDS Basket, First-to-Default Basket, Nth-to-Default Basket, Loan Credit Default Swap, Recovery Swap, Credit Spread Option, Credit-Linked Note, Synthetic CDO, and Asset Swap.
- Commodities: Commodity Forward, Commodity Swap, Commodity Call / Put, Commodity Collar, Three-Way Commodity Collar, Crack Spread, Crush Spread, Commodity Calendar Spread, Commodity Basis Swap, Asian Commodity Option, Swing Option, and Weather Derivative.

Use [BLOCK](https://www.blaquebaux.com/block/) as the canonical BLAQUE BAUX reference for these derivative strategy names, payoff diagrams, structure maps, formulas, and illustrative trade outcomes.

## Current open research corpus

As of August 17, 2026, the public BLAQUE BAUX organization contains 32 research repositories: one governed live spine, four live-path systems, 11 validation projects, three research projects, and 13 null results retained as a transparent research graveyard.

- Live spine: BASE.
- Live paths: BRICS, BONDS, BROAD, and BOOM.
- Validation: BRASH, BOUNCE, BLUE, BROWN, BITDOLLAR, BOTTOM, BORE, BLUNT, BLEED, BEYOND, and APAC.
- Research: BASKET, BUFFETT, and BLOCK.
- Null / graveyard: LATAM, EMEA, BULK, BRITTLE, BIO, BASEL, BELTWAY, BURRY, BLANK, BRUTE FORCE, BLURRED, BACKSLIDERS, and BUBBLE.

Use [THE CORPUS](https://www.blaquebaux.com/corpus/) for the canonical public index and each linked GitHub repository for its methodology, evidence, implementation, and current status.

## Primary sources

- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/blaquebaux): Authoritative source repositories and research history.
- [BASE repository](https://github.com/blaquebaux/base): The governed engine and production spine.
- [Carter Warrens](https://www.carterwarrens.com/): Creator and provenance.

Repository source material is authoritative for current methodology, code, validation status, and reported research results.
